# TimedText:Wara Wara (1930).webm.en.srt

1
00:01:07,098 --> 00:01:10,812
In Hatun Colla, capital of Collasuyo,
lives Princess Wara Wara,
2
00:01:10,933 --> 00:01:14,936
only daughter of Calicuma and Nitaya
and niece of Inca Atahuallpa.
3
00:01:27,420 --> 00:01:30,973
Her life passes peacefully between
the occupations of a Princess,
4
00:01:31,094 --> 00:01:35,316
the ceremonies of the Sun cult and
the traditional festivities of the palace.
5
00:02:56,009 --> 00:03:01,885
But in the midst of the general hubbub,
Arawicu, poet of the Incan empire,
hosts dark forebodings.
6
00:03:48,226 --> 00:03:53,505
Arawicu says that the kind and friendly God
who blessed Manco Kapaj and Mama Ocllo
7
00:03:53,625 --> 00:04:00,091
is now shedding tears of blood over
the guilty rivalry of their descendants
Huáscar and Atahuallpa.
8
00:04:07,111 --> 00:04:12,423
And he says that a terrible and
unknown race, coming from the sea,
will be the executor of divine wrath
9
00:04:12,543 --> 00:04:17,103
because the Sun God has hardened his heart
so as not to be affected by the punishment.
10
00:04:28,486 --> 00:04:32,391
Inca Atahuallpa will be the first to fall
and will be followed in his tragic end
11
00:04:32,511 --> 00:04:35,187
by thousands and thousands
of his unfortunate brothers.
12
00:04:45,783 --> 00:04:52,505
Blood will flow, staining the mountains
and valleys. And it will not stop
until it reaches Hatun Colla.
13
00:05:22,127 --> 00:05:25,275
Kuraka Calicuma refuses to
believe such dark forebodings
14
00:05:25,395 --> 00:05:28,960
and, as punishment for his audacity,
imprisons Arawicu.
15
00:06:47,946 --> 00:06:54,865
Arawicu prophesies that when all is
pain and desolation, when the splendors
of Collasuyo turn to ruins,
16
00:06:54,985 --> 00:06:59,674
the only royal blood not be spilled
will be that of Wara Wara.
17
00:07:23,135 --> 00:07:28,961
In that unhappy moment, says Arawicu,
the salvation or ruin of your people
will depend solely upon you.
18
00:07:54,764 --> 00:08:02,494
Kuraka Calicuma glimpses in the sky
a terrible sign that confirms
the omens of Arawicu.
19
00:08:44,830 --> 00:08:50,509
Already convinced of the dark
destiny that awaits them,
Calicuma asks fortitude of Wara Wara.
20
00:09:26,138 --> 00:09:30,309
The overwhelming impetus of the Spanish
conquest spreads throughout the region.
21
00:09:30,429 --> 00:09:33,391
Pizarro and his reckless army
invade the Incan Empire.
22
00:09:33,511 --> 00:09:35,946
Messengers bring the
bad news to Hatun Colla.
23
00:10:54,727 --> 00:10:59,690
Kuraka Calicuma immediately summons
the Council of Wise Men.
24
00:11:26,996 --> 00:11:31,912
High Priest Huillac Huma also arrives
in response to the urgent call.
25
00:12:03,822 --> 00:12:10,533
The knots reveal that Inca
Atahuallpa has been taken prisoner
by white men, who ask for gold.
26
00:12:10,653 --> 00:12:14,024
A room full of gold
in exchange for his life.
27
00:13:03,709 --> 00:13:06,900
The High Priest Huillac Huma
collects gold from the temple
28
00:13:07,020 --> 00:13:09,663
to buy the precious freedom
of Inca Atahuallpa.
29
00:13:48,443 --> 00:13:52,200
From all parts of the region
the subjects send rafts and
30
00:13:52,328 --> 00:13:56,428
trains of llamas loaded with gold for
the rescue of their beloved sovereign.
31
00:14:22,419 --> 00:14:29,355
Calicuma orders the gold stored
in an underground gallery
whose secret mechanism few know.
32
00:15:08,422 --> 00:15:13,373
But before the gold can be gathered
together, the whites throw themselves
upon the unfortunate Inca.
33
00:15:13,493 --> 00:15:17,332
And, instead of giving him
his promised freedom,
they villainously kill him.
34
00:15:39,062 --> 00:15:44,982
Oblivious to the atrocious crime, the great
Kuraka and the priests gather to offer
to the Sun the sacrifice of a llama.
35
00:15:59,404 --> 00:16:05,308
The High Priest Huillac Huma
looks in the entrails of the animal
for some sign of a good omen.
36
00:16:39,392 --> 00:16:43,319
A messenger from Cusco is
the bearer of the fatal news.
37
00:17:25,898 --> 00:17:33,828
To avenge the death of Inca Atahuallpa,
Huillac Huma lights, on the altar
of sacrifice, the fire of war.
38
00:18:10,811 --> 00:18:13,778
The invading hosts approach...
39
00:18:43,475 --> 00:18:46,611
The time for revenge has arrived.
40
00:18:54,920 --> 00:18:57,916
And so it is that the peaceful and
prosperous region of Hatun Colla
41
00:18:58,036 --> 00:19:00,908
is enveloped in the
blind fury of the struggle.
42
00:19:36,124 --> 00:19:39,079
Shrouded in sad reflections,
Calicuma prepares for war.
43
00:20:10,302 --> 00:20:12,735
Concealing his distress,
Calicuma says goodbye
44
00:20:12,855 --> 00:20:16,069
to his loved ones asking them
to pray to the Sun God for victory.
45
00:20:25,023 --> 00:20:28,749
And, at that same moment,
the sound of a shepherd's flute
46
00:20:28,869 --> 00:20:34,012
comes trembling into the room
of their good-byes,
as a prelude to unknown anguish.
47
00:21:21,794 --> 00:21:27,715
The High Priest asks
the mighty God Pachacamac
to ensure triumph and revenge.
48
00:21:39,475 --> 00:21:43,540
The Incan army confronts
the Spanish troops.
49
00:22:14,958 --> 00:22:18,907
But in the heat of the battle
a terrible misfortune occurs.
50
00:22:47,601 --> 00:22:51,484
The brave Calicuma is dead,
his army is scattered.
51
00:23:02,119 --> 00:23:05,506
Like ravenous wolves the Spaniards
throw themselves upon Hatun Colla.
52
00:23:05,626 --> 00:23:08,698
Slaughter and fire destroy
both inhabitants and buildings.
53
00:23:08,818 --> 00:23:12,066
The violence also reaches Nitaya,
wife of the unfortunate Kuraka.
54
00:23:51,961 --> 00:23:57,916
Huillac Huma and Wara Wara flee by the
underground gallery that hides the gold.
55
00:24:28,172 --> 00:24:32,089
Huillac Huma, knowing that
gold is the spur of the white's ambition,
56
00:24:32,209 --> 00:24:37,127
activates the secret mechanism
to let the waters of the lake
cover the riches forever.
57
00:25:06,304 --> 00:25:11,574
Huillac Huma curses the sinister metal,
and with it the evil, ferocious whites.
He swears that from this moment on,
58
00:25:11,694 --> 00:25:16,307
the only gold the whites will possess
will be that which pierces
their hearts at the tip of a spear.
59
00:25:56,101 --> 00:26:01,097
Of Hatun Colla, its beautiful
palaces, temples and riches,
only bloody ruins remain.
60
00:26:06,428 --> 00:26:10,409
The dominion of the Sun God
succumbs to that of Castilla.
61
00:26:29,531 --> 00:26:32,849
Five years have passed. Huillac Huma,
Wara Wara and a handful of natives
62
00:26:32,969 --> 00:26:37,482
remain hidden in the mountain scrubland
as they prepare with eagerness
the restoration of the empire.
63
00:27:04,095 --> 00:27:09,944
It is the sacred day of Inti Raymi
and the subjects come at the call
of the horn to start the ceremony.
64
00:27:53,781 --> 00:27:57,419
Wara Wara is your hope, your
battle standard and the future queen,
65
00:27:57,539 --> 00:28:01,700
who on the day of victory will be
elevated to the throne of Atahuallpa.
66
00:28:37,887 --> 00:28:42,233
While the young princess goes
in search of a llama for the sacrifice,
67
00:28:42,353 --> 00:28:48,793
the noble Captain Tristán de la Vega,
at the head of a small band of Spaniards,
comes to explore the vicinity.
68
00:29:02,172 --> 00:29:08,161
His squire and good friend Barbolin Gordillo
asks to stop on the march in order
to rest and eat something.
69
00:31:09,557 --> 00:31:17,485
Meanwhile, in the clandestine grotto,
Huillac Huma continues  with the sacred rite,
while awaiting Princess Wara Wara.
70
00:32:15,876 --> 00:32:18,733
The captain and soldiers have disappeared.
71
00:32:18,853 --> 00:32:23,850
Barbolin Gordillo goes in his search,
but what he finds makes him flee in terror.
72
00:33:05,368 --> 00:33:10,580
The shepherds tell that they heard
cries for help, and that
when they arrived at the place
73
00:33:10,699 --> 00:33:15,364
they found Princess Wara Wara
next to the man
already badly wounded.
74
00:33:39,780 --> 00:33:46,659
Huillac Huma says that instead of
a llama, Inti Raymi's feast will end
with the sacrifice of an enemy.
75
00:34:28,730 --> 00:34:32,023
Wara Wara tells that when
looking for a llama to sacrifice
76
00:34:32,143 --> 00:34:35,677
she was suddenly surrounded
by whites, who tried to seize her.
77
00:35:35,760 --> 00:35:40,736
And that the captain,
resolute, took her side
and came to her defence.
78
00:36:22,036 --> 00:36:25,618
The coarse soldiers,
seeing one of themselves fall
and there being one man
79
00:36:25,738 --> 00:36:29,006
who came between them and the
satisfaction of their obscene appetites,
80
00:36:29,126 --> 00:36:31,835
howling with rage, threw
themselves upon the captain.
81
00:37:04,477 --> 00:37:07,887
The brave captain fell wounded,
reliving in his brave deed
82
00:37:08,007 --> 00:37:11,424
the sacrifice of the noble knight
for the honour of his lady.
83
00:38:18,786 --> 00:38:22,841
Wara Wara begs Huillac Huma to
be generous and heal the wounds
84
00:38:22,961 --> 00:38:26,718
of he who was courageous with
a poor and orphaned princess.
85
00:38:58,612 --> 00:39:04,244
As payment for his extraordinary gesture,
the princess orders her subjects
to respect the life of the noble captain
86
00:39:04,364 --> 00:39:07,510
until, healed of his wounds,
he can leave without haste.
87
00:39:43,200 --> 00:39:50,137
With time and the unselfish care of
the princess, the strong, young captain
is healed of his wounds.
88
00:40:35,220 --> 00:40:39,337
They are both young.
She, melancholy dreamer
of the sweet, native race.
89
00:40:39,457 --> 00:40:45,174
He with the excellence of the courteous
men of that gallant and stately
Castilla of the sixteenth century.
90
00:41:57,551 --> 00:42:03,382
The sky with its myriad of stars and
its sad moon, widow of the Sun God,
lights up the night time talk of love.
91
00:42:11,510 --> 00:42:15,502
The legendary lake softly
rocks them in their boat of dreams.
92
00:42:32,354 --> 00:42:38,263
But they are not alone and
the warrior eyes of Apu Mayta
are witness to their passion.
93
00:42:54,211 --> 00:43:01,124
Apu Mayta tells of the romance
and stirs fury and unrest
in the hearts of the subjects.
94
00:43:15,766 --> 00:43:19,702
Daytime brings
a rude awakening.
95
00:44:52,644 --> 00:44:57,584
As much as she looks,
Wara Wara cannot find
a hopeful sign.
96
00:45:51,553 --> 00:45:55,523
The princess remembers the duty
of being faithful to her race...
97
00:46:02,740 --> 00:46:06,428
The imperative to abominate
the executioners of her people.
98
00:46:12,176 --> 00:46:18,154
The obligation to be the spiritual
bulwark in the fight against
the murderers of her parents.
99
00:46:27,126 --> 00:46:33,114
Her love is impossible...
Chasms of hate and revenge separate them...
It is best to say goodbye...
100
00:47:44,731 --> 00:47:49,727
Nearby he meets Barbolin Gordillo
who has returned in search of his captain.
101
00:48:28,420 --> 00:48:32,379
Tristan tells his faithful squire
of the experiences of the last few days.
102
00:49:03,720 --> 00:49:09,653
The captain confesses
the pain of his lost love.
Barbolín offers his selfless help.
103
00:50:41,477 --> 00:50:46,428
But as good as Barbolin's
intentions are to unite the couple,
Wara Wara resists.
104
00:51:38,434 --> 00:51:43,431
The pain of losing Tristan hurts more
and Wara Wara surrenders
to the love that dominates her.
105
00:52:31,053 --> 00:52:35,870
The invading captain and
the treacherous princess
are brought before the High Priest.
106
00:53:31,153 --> 00:53:35,230
Arawicu, prophet of the Incan empire,
aware of the imminent punishment,
107
00:53:35,274 --> 00:53:39,007
decides to discharge an old
debt of gratitude to Wara Wara.
108
00:54:34,364 --> 00:54:37,330
And he anticipates future events.
109
00:54:42,361 --> 00:54:46,369
In punishment for their sacrilegious
passion, Tristan and Wara Wara
110
00:54:46,489 --> 00:54:50,131
are abandoned to their fate
below the depths of a cliff.
111
00:55:14,168 --> 00:55:20,123
Their awakening finds them
at the bottom of a pit,
as cold and dark as the grave.
112
00:55:24,785 --> 00:55:28,752
Little by little, hunger
and thirst overwhelm them.
113
00:55:39,998 --> 00:55:44,913
On the verge of fainting,
Arawicu's foresight
saves them from certain death.
114
00:56:00,571 --> 00:56:05,589
The future is uncertain, but
in the midst of discouragement
Tristan refuses to give up hope.
115
00:56:19,559 --> 00:56:23,518
Eager to save the young couple,
Arawicu asks the white man for help.
116
00:57:25,565 --> 00:57:30,550
Guided by Arawicu,
the Spanish soon come
to the aid of the young couple.
117
00:57:59,614 --> 00:58:04,554
Once his debt of gratitude has been paid,
Arawicu joins the Spaniards.
118
00:58:30,259 --> 00:58:33,203
The resistance has been defeated.
119
00:58:49,256 --> 00:58:53,215
Barbolin kills Apu Mayta,
saving his new friend Arawicu.
120
00:59:59,099 --> 01:00:05,031
The High Priest Huillac Huma is
the last to resign himself to the destiny
that the prophecies had announced.
121
01:00:38,118 --> 01:00:44,106
Free from all threat,
Tristan and Wara Wara
start a new life.
122
01:00:58,033 --> 01:01:01,904
Subtitles:
corvusalbus, ChaiWalla
